lucky-guy.en: Lucky Guy's wardrobe is tiny: one S, three A, ten B, six C, and four collab skins. The Maid Outfit meme carries him; fans felt neglected until Ratatosk finally gave him a real S.
lucky-guy.cn: 幸运儿衣柜很小，仅1稀世、3奇珍、10独特、6罕见和4联动；女仆装梗出圈，玩家一直觉得被忽视，直到鼠托斯克才迎来真正的金皮。

doctor.en: Doctor has a huge early-survivor wardrobe: five S, eleven A, twenty-three B, seven C. Firefly and Blossom regularly top best-skin polls; fans are satisfied, not neglected.
doctor.cn: 医生衣柜庞大，共5稀世、11奇珍、23独特、7罕见；流萤与浴火重生常进最好看榜单，玩家满意，不觉得被忽视。

lawyer.en: Lawyer was long neglected with only one S among six A, seventeen B, eight C, and five collabs; collabs carry his popularity. Inverse Mercury in 2024 only partly fixed the neglect.
lawyer.cn: 律师长期被忽视，仅1稀世，另有6奇珍、17独特、8罕见和5联动；靠联动撑人气，2024逆水银只是部分缓解了被忽视感。

thief.en: Thief's mid-size wardrobe has two S, six A, nineteen B, and six C. Lion Dance's rare prestige defines him; overall okay—not top priority, but not abandoned.
thief.cn: 盗贼衣柜中等，2稀世、6奇珍、19独特、6罕见；舞狮的稀有品质是代表作，整体尚可，不算亲儿子也不算被放弃。

gardener.en: As mascot, Gardener has a huge wardrobe: seven S, ten A, twenty-one B, nine C, and five collabs. Ghost Girl and Cosmic Witch are regulars at the top of beauty polls; fans are spoiled, never neglected.
gardener.cn: 园丁作为看板娘，衣柜最大：7稀世、10奇珍、21独特、9罕见、5联动；幽灵少女和星空女巫常居最好看榜前列，玩家被宠坏，从未被忽视。

magician.en: Magician's wardrobe is mid-to-large: three S, eight A, seventeen B, seven C, and one collab. Treasure and Blue Aladdin are classics; steady supply means mildly loved, not neglected.
magician.cn: 魔术师衣柜中上，3稀世、8奇珍、17独特、7罕见、1联动；寻宝与蓝阿拉丁是经典，新金持续稳定，不算被忽视，中规中矩。

explorer.en: Explorer has a small wardrobe of about 37 skins, with only two S—Lilliputian and Editor-in-Chief—after years of neglect. Fans still feel neglected despite lore-fitting A skins like Icarus.
explorer.cn: 冒险家衣柜较小，约37件，仅2件稀世（小人国、主编），时隔多年才出新金；虽有伊卡洛斯等贴合人设的奇珍，玩家仍觉被忽视。

mercenary.en: Mercenary is a wardrobe king with about 47 skins, four plus one S and seven collabs. Cheshire Cat and Eagle's Dance are enduring icons, and fans feel well-fed.
mercenary.cn: 佣兵衣柜之王，约47件，金皮4+1，联动7个；柴郡猫与鹰之舞是常青代表，玩家觉得不缺皮肤。

coordinator.en: Coordinator has about 49 skins, including 5 S-tier and 9 collabs. Dance, Amazonite, and Sway lead beauty votes; Black Swan proves a cheap A-tier can be beloved. She is not neglected.
coordinator.cn: 空军约49件时装，含5金9联动。雪舞、琥珀、摇曳领跑颜值投票，黑天鹅证明便宜紫皮也能受欢迎，并未被忽视。

mechanic.en: Mechanic has the largest wardrobe, about 54 skins with 4 S-tier and a deep B-tier bench. Lockheart, Red Hood, and Everlasting lead; decoder mains feel spoiled.
mechanic.cn: 机械师衣柜最厚，约54件含4金，B级皮肤储备深。锁心、小红帽、永生花领衔，解码位玩家备受宠爱。

forward.en: Forward has about 42 skins, with 3 S-tier led by Locomotive. Sporty and meme A-tiers carry; collabs add hype, but overall less beauty buzz than female characters, giving a mild neglected feel.
forward.cn: 前锋约42件时装，3金由末班车领衔。运动梗皮为主，联动加持，但颜值讨论度不如女性角色，略有冷落感。

the-minds-eye.en: Mind's Eye has about 37 skins, including 5 S-tier. Architect, Golden Cake, and charity Starlight Maiden are emotional standouts; cheap A-tiers are beloved, but low pick rate gives a slightly neglected feel.
the-minds-eye.cn: 盲女约37件时装，含5金。建筑师、金蛋糕与公益星光少女最动人，便宜紫皮口碑好，但出场率低略显冷门。

priestess.en: Priestess has a very large wardrobe of about 45, including 6 top-tier skins with an SS. Morgan and Ephemeral are beloved standouts; fans do not feel neglected.
priestess.cn: 祭司时装非常多，约45套，含6件顶级品质并有虚妄杰作。摩根勒菲和惊鸿最受欢迎，玩家没有被忽视感。

perfumer.en: Perfumer has one of the richest wardrobes, about 47, with 5 non-collab S-tiers plus SS Mnemosyne's Dream. Tonight or Never and Red Shoes prove cheap A-tiers can outshine S-tiers in popularity.
perfumer.cn: 调香师时装极多，约47套，含5件非联动金皮及SS记忆之梦。今夜不再和红舞鞋人气最高，便宜紫皮也能超越金皮，不被冷落。

cowboy.en: Cowboy is relatively neglected, with about 29 skins and only 2 S-tiers, and long gaps before Exiled Immortal. King's Tailor remains his soul skin.
cowboy.cn: 牛仔时装较少，约29套，仅2金，长期被吐槽冷门，直到谪仙才稍有改善，国王的裁缝仍是本命。

female-dancer.en: Female Dancer has a solid mid-size wardrobe of about 42 with 5 S-tiers. Kroto and Valkyrie are consensus beauties; she is not neglected.
female-dancer.cn: 舞女时装中等偏多，约42套，含5金。克罗托和女武神口碑最好，整体不受冷落。

seer.en: Seer has roughly 39 outfits, including the SS Prophet of Yore and two non-collaboration S tiers. The White skin draws both love and criticism for its price and rarity. Fans hope for a shop S tier rather than more crossovers.
seer.cn: 先知约39套，含虚妄杰作及两款非联动S。纯白先知因高价绝版备受争议，玩家更希望出商城金而非仅联动。

embalmer.en: Embalmer, one of the most popular survivors, has about 35 outfits including four S tiers. Exorcist, Phoenix, and Hamlet are all beloved, so his wardrobe feels well cared for.
embalmer.cn: 入殓师人气极高，约35套含四款S。驱魔人、凤凰、哈姆雷特皆受喜爱，时装待遇良好，无冷落感。

prospector.en: Prospector has a large 36-skin wardrobe (4S, 10A, 13B, 5C, 4 collab), led by Nymph contest winner Bird of Prey (global release January 2025) and the classic Soul Catcher. Fans feel well-treated, not neglected.
prospector.cn: 共36套（4S+10A+13B+5C+4联动），由2024妙笔优选枭徒（2025年1月全球上线）和经典引魂人领衔，玩家觉得待遇好，未被忽视。

enchantress.en: Enchantress has 32 outfits (5S, 9A, 13B, 5C) and no collabs, but two player-voted Nymph S tiers: Fate era and Nocturne (2025 winner, global February 2026). Fans feel satisfied.
enchantress.cn: 共32套（5S+9A+13B+5C），无联动，但有两款玩家投票的妙笔S：宿命和夜之咏叹调（2025优胜，2026年2月全球上线），玩家满意。

wildling.en: Wildling has a small 22-skin wardrobe (2S, 5A, 10B, 5C) and a six-year S-tier gap until Fairyland in 2025. His boar gameplay is unpopular, so fans feel neglected despite cheap favorites like Wild Child.
wildling.cn: 共22套（2S+5A+10B+5C），时隔6年才在2025年迎来第二款S仙境。野猪机制人气低，玩家普遍觉得被忽视，只能靠野孩子等便宜皮安慰。

acrobat.en: Acrobat has a large 31-skin wardrobe (4S, 5A, 10B, 5C, 7 collabs), led by Persona JOKER/CROW collaborations, original Tea Party and Rain Pearl, plus voted Dodger (2025 winner). Fans feel well-treated.
acrobat.cn: 共31套（4S+5A+10B+5C+7联动），由P5的JOKER/CROW联动、原创茶会、雨珍珠和演绎道奇（2025优胜）领衔，待遇很好。

first-officer.en: First Officer has a medium 25-skin wardrobe (2S, 5A, 10B, 5C, 3 collabs), carried by Captain Hook and Persona CROW/Akechi. Original S tiers are thin—only Flicker of Life (2025, essence-only)—so fans feel mixed.
first-officer.cn: 共25套（2S+5A+10B+5C+3联动），靠胡克船长和P5的CROW/明智撑场，原创S仅生命之光（2025精华限定），玩家评价两极。

barmaid.en: Barmaid has a large 34-skin wardrobe (3S, 9A, 14B, 5C, 3 collabs) with True Proof, summer Sea Salt, voted So Long at Fair (2025 winner, global), and Halloween's Last Dance. Fans feel well-treated.
barmaid.cn: 共34套（3S+9A+14B+5C+3联动），有真实证明、夏日海盐特调、演绎盛会落幕（2025优胜全球）和万圣最后一舞，玩家满意。

postman.en: Postman has 26 costumes—2 S-tier, 7 A-tier, 10 B-tier, 5 C-tier, and 2 collab—headlined by limited S The Embrace and Christmas Messenger. Embrace is popular, but the Christmas Wick model drew complaints.
postman.cn: 邮差共26件时装（2稀世/7奇珍/10独特/5罕见/2联动），以限定稀世初拥和圣诞信使为代表；初拥人气最高，圣诞犬模曾因投诉优化。

grave-keeper.en: Grave Keeper has 27 costumes—2 S-tier, 8 A-tier, 11 B-tier, 5 C-tier, and 1 collab. Desolate Sand and Epitaph stand out; the steady supply means he isn't neglected.
grave-keeper.cn: 守墓人共27件时装（2稀世/8奇珍/11独特/5罕见/1联动），荒芜之沙与墓志铭最突出，供给稳定不算被冷落。

prisoner.en: Prisoner has 34 costumes—3 S-tier, 8 A-tier, 13 B-tier, 5 C-tier, and 5 collab—one of the richest survivor wardrobes. Winter Cicada, Dazai, and Graduation Day are fan favorites.
prisoner.cn: “囚徒”共34件时装（3稀世/8奇珍/13独特/5罕见/5联动），是求生者中时装库最富之一，冬蝉、太宰治、毕业典礼最受欢迎。

entomologist.en: Entomologist has 29 costumes—4 S-tier, 8 A-tier, 10 B-tier, 5 C-tier, and 2 collab. Sophia and Ghost Candle are standout beauties; her wardrobe is rich and well received.
entomologist.cn: 昆虫学者共29件时装（4稀世/8奇珍/10独特/5罕见/2联动），索菲亚与鬼烛为颜值顶梁，整体时装库丰富受欢迎。

painter.en: Painter has 26 costumes—3 S-tier, 6 A-tier, 8 B-tier, 5 C-tier, and 4 collab. Golden Ratio and Narcissus are iconic beauties, and fans feel well treated.
painter.cn: 画家共26件时装（3稀世/6奇珍/8独特/5罕见/4联动），黄金比例与水仙是标志性美皮，玩家觉得待遇很好。

batter.en: Batter has 20 costumes—2 S-tier, 5 A-tier, 8 B-tier, and 5 C-tier—a smaller wardrobe than most. Lava Cake is beloved, Champion Helmsman is divisive, and fans feel somewhat neglected compared with popular survivors.
batter.cn: 击球手共20件时装（2稀世/5奇珍/8独特/5罕见），数量偏少，熔岩蛋糕最爱、冠军舵手评价分化，玩家略感被冷落。

toy-merchant.en: Toy Merchant has a sizable mid-size wardrobe of about 30 costumes with 2 S-tiers. Fans love Myriad Blossoms and Hidden but feel she waits long between S-tiers.
toy-merchant.cn: 玩具商时装约30件、稀世2件，花千树和藏口碑最好，但玩家觉得S级更新慢、有被忽视感。

psychologist.en: Psychologist is a wardrobe favorite with about 24 costumes, anchored by the Ada-Emil couple skins; Everlasting Night is routinely cited as one of the most beautiful female S-tiers.
psychologist.cn: “心理学家”时装约24件，靠与病患的情侣皮肤长夜撑起口碑，常被视为最美女皮肤之一，不存在被忽视。

patient.en: Patient mirrors Psychologist with about 24 costumes and three S-tiers; Luminary is his defining beloved skin, and fans feel well treated as a couple character.
patient.cn: 病患时装约24件、稀世3件，流光/发光体为代表作，作为情侣角色之一玩家满意度高。

novelist.en: Novelist has about 26 costumes but only one original S-tier, relying on collaborations; fans feel neglected for original high-tier despite rich B-tier lore.
novelist.cn: 小说家时装约26件但原创稀世仅1件，靠联动撑场面，玩家常抱怨原创高阶太少。

little-girl.en: Little Girl has a premium wardrobe of about 27 costumes, including one SS and three S-tiers; Eurydice and Source of Evil are perennial most-beautiful picks, so no neglect.
little-girl.cn: “小女孩”时装约27件、含虚妄铂金及3稀世，欧律狄刻与罪恶之源常年入选最好看榜单，富养角色。

weeping-clown.en: Weeping Clown has a small wardrobe of about 18 costumes with two S-tiers; Swallow of Deception is iconic, but fans feel neglected by long gaps and joke S-tiers like Breezy Snail.
weeping-clown.cn: 哭泣小丑时装偏少，约18件、稀世2件，欺诈之燕经典但新S微风蜗牛偏幼稚，玩家常感被忽视。

professor.en: Professor has 17 costumes total per the Cosmetics table's S/A/B/C navigation; after a four-year S-tier gap from 2022 to 2026, Ecdysis arrived, yet fans feel neglected despite Ao Lie's CN popularity.
professor.cn: 共17套，S断档4年直到蜕变，敖烈CN限定最受欢迎，粉丝多觉被忽视。

antiquarian.en: Antiquarian has 24 total costumes—S3, A10, B6, C5—including Bai Ze S, Serpent Flag S, and Crow A; her rich Chinese-style wardrobe leaves fans well-treated.
antiquarian.cn: 共24套（S3/A10/B6/C5），含白泽S、蛇旗S、乌鸦A，国风库存丰厚，粉丝普遍满意。

composer.en: Composer has 19 total costumes—S Dragon Hunter and Phantom Sail, A5, B6, C6—and a solid mid-size wardrobe; his Deduction Star win keeps fans content.
composer.cn: 共19套，S龙之猎人与幻影之帆，A5/B6/C6，推理之星获奖，衣柜中规中矩粉丝尚满意。

journalist.en: Journalist has 23 total costumes, with S-tiers Eternity, Kaede, and Miss Watson, A-tiers Alice, Dreaded, Golden, Homeward, Ib, and Xiao Yu, and B9, a large beautiful wardrobe that spoils fans.
journalist.cn: 共23套，永恒、枫、沃森小姐为S，爱丽丝、恐怖、金色、归途、伊布、小宇为A，B9，衣柜又大又美，粉丝公认富婆。

aeroplanist.en: Aeroplanist has 15 outfits total: S Stellar Wings, A Aviatorus Rotor and Strange Wang, plus 5 B and 5 C. His small male wardrobe feels overlooked, and fans feel neglected.
aeroplanist.cn: 共15套：金皮星翼、紫皮Aviatorus Rotor和怪奇王，蓝绿各5。男角色衣柜小、存在感低，粉丝常喊被忽视。

cheerleader.en: Cheerleader has 22 outfits: S Fluorite Woven Heart; A BISHOP, Congregator, OPH, Resonant Rising Melody, Maltese; 8 B including Haidilao. This new female is well-treated, with no neglect.
cheerleader.cn: 共22套：金皮萤石织心，紫皮BISHOP、Congregator、OPH、共鸣旋律、马耳他，蓝皮8件含海底捞。新女角待遇好，粉丝不觉被忽视。

puppeteer.en: Puppeteer has a small, curated 14-piece wardrobe: 1 S, 3 A, 5 B, 5 C. KING-h1 is the consensus standout; ROOK-e4 and Winter Chimes are beloved cheap Bs. Fans feel okay for a 2024 survivor but want a new S accessory.
puppeteer.cn: 共14件，1金3紫5蓝5绿，小而精。KING-h1是公认代表作，ROOK-e4和雪铃铛是便宜好蓝皮。2024求生者不亏，但盼新金挂。

fire-investigator.en: Fire Investigator has a balanced 14-piece wardrobe (1 S, 4 A, 4 B, 5 C). Spirit Fox is a universally loved S; Lumina is a beloved free B. Beanie and LEONARD shop-collab As show price doesn't equal popularity.
fire-investigator.cn: 共14件，1金4紫4蓝5绿，分布均衡。灵狐是公认最美金皮，尘光是口碑极好的免费蓝皮；红小豆和LEONARD联动商城紫皮证明贵≠最受欢迎。

faro-lady.en: Faro Lady has 16 outfits (1 S, 5 A, 5 B, 5 C), one of the fuller wardrobes among recent survivors. Mark of Prey and the double P5R collab make her feel favored, and an upcoming Deduction Star A will add more.
faro-lady.cn: 共16件（1金5紫5蓝5绿），在近年新角色中衣柜算丰富。猎物的印记加双P5R联动让她显得受宠，还有待上的演绎之星紫皮。

knight.en: Knight has an S-heavy wardrobe for his age, with 15 outfits (3 S, 4 A, 3 B, 5 C). Himmel collab and Red Knight are dual flagships; KFC Asst K/Mentor K are CN-only collabs, showing server split. Fans feel favored, with Nymph and esports skins teased.
knight.cn: 上线不久金皮已不少，共15件3金4紫3蓝5绿。辛美尔联动和红骑士双招牌；KFC的Asst K/Mentor K是国服限定。玩家受宠，宁芙和电竞皮待上。

meteorologist.en: Meteorologist has a compact 12-piece wardrobe (2 S, 1 A, 6 B, 3 C). The Frieren collab dominates popularity; original Windchaser is solid. The B-heavy set feels slightly neglected in A-tier variety.
meteorologist.cn: 共12件2金1紫6蓝3绿，很紧凑。芙莉莲联动人气断层领先，原创Windchaser不错；蓝皮多紫皮少，略显被冷落。

archer.en: Archer has the smallest wardrobe at 11 (1 S, 2 A, 5 B, 3 C). The S and Pinky carry hype; Sleepy Mytyl is a beloved B. CN Extra versus global Predator exclusives spark a neglect debate.
archer.cn: 衣柜最小，11件1金2紫5蓝3绿。金皮和Pinky撑人气，睡不醒的米蒂尔是最爱蓝皮；国服Extra和国际服Predator独占引发偏心之争。

escapologist.en: Since May 2025, Escapologist has six skins—one limited S (Duat), one A (Qiu Xing), one B (Fanshengzhe), three C. Too new to feel neglected, but fans want more non-Egyptian A-tier.
escapologist.cn: 2025年5月上线，共6件：限定金死生之谕、紫囚星、蓝返生者、3绿。太新谈不上被忽视，但玩家想要更多非埃及风紫皮。

lanternist.en: Lanternist's wardrobe grew to nine skins in under a year—one S (Ci'an Shengyan), one A (Robin), three B (Mengyou, Leyuan, Shiyanzhe), three C, one collab—from S39E2 to S43E3. The S and Robin carry affection. Players generally like it, with no neglect narrative yet.
lanternist.cn: 上线不到一年便增至9件：金此岸盛筵、紫罗宾、蓝梦游/乐园/誓言者、3绿、联动，从S39E2到S43E3。玩家普遍喜欢，暂无被忽视的说法。

matador.en: Since February 2026, Matador has six skins—one limited S (Dasein), one collab S (Li Bing), two B (Poxiao, Hefu), two C (initial outfits)—and no A yet. Dasein carries hype. Matador is strong, too new for neglect.
matador.cn: 2026年2月上线仅6件：限定金此在无栖撑热度+联动金李饼+2蓝破晓/荷负+2绿初始旧装，无紫皮。斗牛士强度高时装少但不算被忽视。

mime-artist.en: Since June 2026, Mime Artist has a tiny four-skin wardrobe—one S, one B, two C—with no A yet. Dream Traveler is loved, B Meihao Shidai is cost-effective. Fans already ask for more A-tier skins and accessories despite the newness.
mime-artist.cn: 2026年6月上线仅4件：1金1蓝2绿，无紫皮。限定金梦旅人撑场，B美好时代性价比高。太新但已有玩家喊要新紫挂。

prodigy.en: Prodigy launched on September 30, 2026, with the smallest three-skin wardrobe—one S (Falsehood), one B (Voice, arriving October 8), one C (initial). Too early for neglect, but a limited S at launch is debated.
prodigy.cn: 9月30日刚上线只有3件，限定金虚妄+蓝流放者之声（10月8日）+初始。衣柜最小，还谈不上忽视，但新生日即限定金引发微词。
